page.layout: One page of running text. Marginal notes in the right margin: "Lot captus" beside the line "Quod cum", "Gen.15." with "Abrae promissa" beside "Peridem tempus", "Gen.17." beside "Tum ei atq", and "Circumcisio Gen.16." beside the last line.

main_text.p: tea nullum inter mortales certamen fuiffet. Sed adverfum hos,qui bello vicina tentabant, reges Sodomorum, Gomorrhæorum vicinarumq; regionum in prælium erumpunt: primoq; impetu fufi,victoriam concefsere. Tum a victoribus Sodoma direpta, prædæ hoftibus fuit, ductufq; Lot in captivitatem. Quod cumLot captus, & liberatus. Abram comperiflet, propere armatis fervis fuis,numero trecentis,decem & octo, reges victoria feroces, exutos prædaarmifq; in fugam compulit. Tum a Melchifedec facerdote benedictus eft, eidemq; decimas prædæ dedit. Reliqua his,quibus ereptæ erant, reddidit. Peridem tempusGen.15. Abrae promissa. Abrae Dominus locutus eft, multiplicans dumq; femen ejus,ficut arenas maris ftellafq; cæli, fpopondit: peregrinumq; ejus femen prædictum futurum, ac pofteros in hoftili folo per quadringentos annos laturos fervitium, poftea libertati reftituendos. Tum ei atq; uxori ejus, adjectiGen.17.one unius litteræ nomen immutatum:ita nunc ex Abram Abraam, ex Sara Sarra difcitur. Cujus quidem rei non inane myfterium non eft hujus operis exponere. Eodem tempore Abraæ lex circum-Circumcisio Gen.16.

page.notes: Printed text is set in roman type with italic note labels. The end of the last line, "circum-", is faint at the scan edge; the hyphen is read as printed and the word continues on the next page. "ftel-lafq" is read as "lafq" [?] because the final letters are faint. The printed "fufi,vi-" and "Lot ca-ptus" are kept as printed. The note "Gen.15." and "Abrae promissa" are partly faint; the word "promissa" is read as printed. Show-through from the reverse side is not transcribed. The running head is taken from the top of the page with the number 9.
